model: alpha1,16 unnormalised body Cauchy directions, inverse Fourier factor (2*pi)^-5
API: Direct outward Arb five-component first jet (value plus four physical tail derivatives), all3504 terms, no exact rational log-stencil. Exact integer nodes/deltas and rational initial derivative inputs; DD R0=P0/d,Rj=(Pj-delta_j R0)/d.

qualification.test: all five new direct-Arb balls contain the corresponding stored043 balls and have width <= max(abs endpoints,1e-6)*2^-40; one point, second precision only if needed; not new coverage progress

precision_retry: Retry only if nonfinite/insufficient width or center H interval straddles target; never retry merely because the whole-box geometric certificate fails. At512 unresolved -> diagnostic stop, retain box.

initial_cover.domain: positive unit face ordered tail y1>=y2>=y3>=y4
initial_cover.order: ascending nested loops i1=0..31,i2=0..i1,i3=0..i2,i4=0..i3; FIFO pending queue; failed children appended after all existing pending leaves

anchor_rule.candidates1to3: midpoint + (minimum side/4096)*(1,beta,beta^2,beta^3), beta respectively1/8,1/16,1/32; test in this fixed order, take first exact eligible
anchor_rule.eligibility: all280 true-vertex projections exactly nonzero and distinct; all four candidates remain in original closed box; geometry-only rejected candidates are not density evaluations
anchor_rule.if_none_eligible: diagnostic stop, keep this box pending; never drop box or invoke ordinary DD on repeated/zero nodes

whole_box_certificate: 043 lower log-paraboloid, exact Q=I4/4-J4/36, all16 physical box corners relative to chosen anchor, directed dyadic H and gradlogH endpoints; min exact rational log margin>0
split_rule: failed whole-box certificate -> bisect longest side, tie lowest coordinate index, closed lower and upper children; do not remove any unsolved region

finite_batch_limits.count: qualification excluded from new anchors, but included in wall time; each geometric new coordinate counted once, numeric precision retries recorded separately
finite_batch_limits.checkpoint: full FIFO queue, exact roots and split/pass tree, anchor cache and active partial cone sum; persistent scratch outside Git; lock source/registration/input fingerprint; save after every completed leaf and immediately on limit

counterexample_stop: if a fully enclosed center H upper endpoint<1/10000, save strict counterexample to this fixed-epsilon H target and stop; no C5 or full-G failure claim
allowed_claim: partial certified cover plus full remaining queue, unless the entire tree actually closes; no projection singularity assumption on whole boxes, no global-g/C5 claim, no MATLAB, no commits, no edits to frozen043/017/018 or others
